control_failures.control_label: guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast
receipt, magazining and reconciliation of explosives

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: high potential incident during cleaning and preparation on P-7113

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control BLAST_GUARDING_AND_CLEARANCE: the guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.
Control EXPLOSIVES_RECONCILIATION: the receipt, magazining and reconciliation of explosives was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast on P-7113 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in charging and firing, specifically charging, tying in and guarding a blast. P-7113 (export transfer pumps) is in service for tank-to-jetty product transfer, same seal class as the Marrindal family. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast was not in place. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 20 March 2023 a high potential incident was recorded on P-7113 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during cleaning and preparation; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
